notes.title: Achievements and tutorials added!
notes.notes:
[h1][b][u]What's New[/u][/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]Achievements Added: [/b]Unlockable achievements are now available! Challenge yourself by completing specific tasks in-game to earn them.
[*] [b]New Tutorials:[/b] We’ve introduced step-by-step tutorials to help new players learn the basics quickly and give returning players a refresher on key mechanics.
[*] [b]Bug Fixes:[/b] Several bugs reported by the community have been addressed, improving stability and overall performance.
[*] [b] Camera Improvements: [/b]We’ve refined the camera controls to make navigation smoother and enhance the player experience.

[h2][b]Enjoy the update, and as always, we welcome your feedback![/b][/h2]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 + More Tutorials Coming!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45209149/f52e554ef074e678c0bddbdc11014590153aca85.jpg[/img]Hello Adventurers,

First off, a huge “thank you” to everyone who played [b]Azura’s Crystals [/b]during the [b]Taipei Game Show[/b]! Your feedback has been invaluable, and we’re excited to share our latest update. Here’s what you can expect in [b]Patch 1.0.5[/b]:

[b]Auto Saves:[/b] Never lose progress again! The game will now automatically save after each quest!
[b]Tutorial Input Lock Fix:[/b] Resolved a rare issue that caused controls to become unresponsive during the tutorial.
[b]Camera Transition Improvements: [/b]Enjoy smoother camera movement and an overall better flow during dialogue scenes.
[b]Gamepad Cursor Visibility:[/b] When using a controller, the cursor is now hidden for a more seamless gameplay experience.
[b]Ancient Ruins Brenda’s Quest Bug Fix:[/b] Addressed a rare bug that prevented players from completing Brenda’s quest line in the Ancient Ruins.

[b]What’s Next?[/b]
We’re currently working on adding more tutorials in the early portions of the game. These improvements will guide new players more thoroughly through the mechanics and ensure a smoother journey for everyone.

Thank you again for your support—please keep the feedback coming! We’ll continue to work hard and deliver the best possible experience in [b]Azura’s Crystals[/b].

— The Dev Team
